profile.personality: An ancestral model of scholarship for Scribonia; her spellbook manifestation also expresses joy and companionship.
profile.achievements: Legendary Zuk’Teuc archmage and demigod identified by Vesperax as Keeper of the Arcane Secrets. Legend Lore reveals her arrival carrying books and maps.
profile.relationships: Scribonia models Manifest Mind after her. Vesperax describes her duty to the First God; Ser Kurayami welcomes her in the recovered arrival vision.
